summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-domiciled SPAC listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K reporting that its September 10, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting was adjourned by the Chairman without any proposals being put to a vote, including the proposed business combination with WISeSat.Space Corp. Trust held approximately $10.66 per share as of September 8, 2026, and the record date remains August 17, 2026. The reconvened meeting date and extended redemption deadline will be announced; Advantage Proxy serves as proxy solicitor. Watch for redemption levels and whether the extension signals insufficient votes for the de-SPAC.
